correctness.rationale: Finite p-free molecular norms reduce rigorously to finitely many spanning-tree flow costs by p-concave cycle elimination; every F1 transport decomposes onto at most three edges. Jensen yields the universal factor. At an elongated rectangle, an interior directional derivative with unit weighted source norm gives precisely three equal limiting edge loads, while other trees diverge. This proves the all-p all-aspect supremum and boundary p=1. A standalone 16-tree diagnostic is auxiliary only.
